title: orchis tridentata subsp. hanrii
intro: Orchis tridentata subsp. hanrii, commonly known as Hanrii orchid, is a species of orchid that belongs to the Orchidaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and treating various skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Hanrii orchid are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Orchis tridentata subsp. hanrii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
